projects.title: Basecamp
projects.description: Trip-planning app for weekend riders: routes, fuel stops, weather.
projects.intro: A trip-planning app that helps weekend riders plan routes, fuel stops and weather windows in one place.
projects.overview: Sample text: replace this with your own story. Basecamp started as a spreadsheet a riding group shared before every trip.
projects.challenge: Riders were juggling maps, weather apps and group chats. Fuel ranges and closed passes caught people out.
projects.approach: I interviewed 12 riders, mapped how they plan a weekend, and prototyped a single timeline view that combines route, fuel and weather.
projects.outcome: The beta launched to 400 riders. Planning a two-day route dropped from an evening to about 20 minutes.

projects.title: Ridgeline Coffee
projects.description: Identity and packaging for a small-batch mountain roastery.
projects.intro: Identity and packaging for a small-batch roastery working with high-altitude farms.
projects.overview: Sample text: replace this with your own story.
projects.challenge: The roastery needed to stand out on crowded café shelves without looking like every other craft brand.
projects.approach: Contour lines from each farm's map became the pattern system, with one colour per altitude band.
projects.outcome: Launched across 3 cafés and an online shop.

about.heading: Two kinds of terrain
about.lead: I'm a designer who works the way I ride: plan the route, read the ground, and adjust when the trail washes out.
about.body:
Most of my work is brand identity and digital product design for small teams who need things to look sharp and work hard. Long rides taught me to pack light, so my design does the same: fewer parts, each one earning its place.

Off the clock I'm on a Triumph Scrambler 1200, usually heading somewhere the tarmac gives up.
about.skills: Brand identity, UI / UX, Design systems, Prototyping, Illustration, Figma
